# Stack

> Stack is a directory of AI stacks for anything people build with AI: curated tools, models, and workflows as open JSON. Design, video, compute, and agentic tools are the live stacks, and anyone can propose another.

Browse the Markdown and JSON directly on GitHub or in a local checkout. Every catalog entry uses the same four fields: name, link, one-line description, and a free, freemium, or paid tag.

## Docs

- [Collection README](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/README.md): Taxonomy, table of contents, category highlights, example workflow, and contributor credits.
- [Published guides](https://aunysillyme.dev/stack/): The separately maintained guide directory.
- [Video guide](https://aunysillyme.dev/stack/video/): Read the illustrated workflows and model comparison.
- [Design guide](https://aunysillyme.dev/stack/design/): Core design tools, step-by-step workflows, and the searchable inventory.
- [Design stack](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/01-design-stack/README.md): 35 core tools, 5 workflows, and a 319-entry inventory across 15 categories.
- [Design inventory (plain text)](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/01-design-stack/inventory.md): Full 319-entry table plus `free/`, `freemium/`, and `premium/` subfolders.
- [Video stack](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/02-video-stack/README.md): Generation, editing, upscaling, lip-sync, and the original image-to-video inventory.
- [Video inventory (plain text)](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/02-video-stack/inventory.md): 54 video entries plus `free/`, `freemium/`, and `premium/` subfolders.
- [Compute stack](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/03-compute-stack/README.md): 19 GPU cloud and inference API entries.
- [Agentic tools](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/04-agentic-stack/README.md): 18 coding agents, MCP servers, and frameworks.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Entry fields, workflow format, author credit, and certification.

## Reference

- [Category catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/catalog.json): Numbered top-level stack folders (`01-design-stack`, `02-video-stack`, `03-compute-stack`, `04-agentic-stack`).
- [Design metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/01-design-stack/stack.json): Paths for curated design tools, workflows, resource inventory, and community entries.
- [Video metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/02-video-stack/stack.json): Paths for curated video workflows, model inventory, and community entries.
- [Compute metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/03-compute-stack/stack.json): Paths for GPU clouds, inference APIs, and community entries.
- [Agentic metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/04-agentic-stack/stack.json): Paths for coding agents, MCP, frameworks, and community entries.
- [Workflow template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/templates/workflow.json): Fields for a new community submission.
- [License coverage](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/LICENSE.md): Terms for editorial data, original descriptions, scripts, and GitHub Actions configuration.
- [Contributor certification](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTOR-CERTIFICATION.md): How to confirm the right to submit a pull request under the repository licenses.

## Common questions

- [Best AI tools for video generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/02-video-stack/inventory.json): Dated model and platform entries plus newer generation, editing, upscaling, and lip-sync pages. Workflows are in 02-video-stack/canonical.json.
- [AI tools for animation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/02-video-stack/canonical.json): Animation is part of the video stack.
- [AI tools designers use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/01-design-stack/canonical.json): 35 core tools and 5 workflows, plus the 319-entry 01-design-stack/inventory.json and free/freemium/premium subfolders.
- [AI tools for UI design](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/01-design-stack/README.md): The web interface workflow, UI libraries, UI builders, and design-to-code.
- [Where to run a model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/03-compute-stack/inventory.json): GPU clouds and inference APIs with a free, freemium, or paid tag.
- [Coding agents and MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/04-agentic-stack/inventory.json): Claude Code, the Agent SDK, MCP, Gemini CLI, ADK, Jules, Codex, Cursor, and agent frameworks.
- [How to submit a workflow](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Start from templates/workflow.json.
- [Add a new kind of stack](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#propose-a-new-stack): Open a [New stack issue](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/issues/new?template=new-stack.yml) with the proposed tools and workflow.

## Optional

- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Editing and offline validation.
- [Maintainer review](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINING.md): Review, consent, and credit checks.
